evidence.detail: The nested class is an immutable three-field record: one integer dependency object ID plus two Strings describing the dependency asset/context and finding reason.

OsrsMapDependencyScanner constructs these records for MISSING_DEFINITION, MISSING_SEQUENCE, frame/keyframe failures, decode errors and related dependency findings while recursively checking spawned object definitions and animation dependencies.

The scanner stores List<OsrsMapDependencyScanner$a> per root object and emits each record under the exact report heading 'Findings (one example spawn per region/root object/dependency):', formatting object=<root>, dependencyObject=<record id>, the record asset text and reason.

candidates.note: DependencyFinding is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for the scanner's immutable per-dependency finding record. No surviving original nested source noun is asserted; confidence is 0.997.

evidence.detail: The nested interface has exactly one method accept(int,int,int,int).
OsrsMapDependencyScanner's static landscape parser decodes delta-compressed object IDs and packed locations, then invokes the callback with objectId, packed local location, object type and rotation.
OsrsMapDependencyScannerTest supplies a lambda of this interface and verifies the decoded callback tuple as '32769:0:10:2', independently fixing the four callback values and landscape-object role.
The main scanner uses the same callback while traversing packed OSRS landscape data to count spawns and seed recursive object dependency checks.

evidence.detail: The AutoCloseable helper owns one shared read-only RandomAccessFile for <prefix>.dat plus a lazily opened map of <prefix>.idxN RandomAccessFiles under a configured cache Path and prefix.

Its read method selects an index file by cache index, constructs the existing rs/cache/a store reader with shared data/index handles and index+1, reads a numeric archive/file ID, and optionally GZIP-decompresses the returned bytes.
OsrsMapDependencyScanner owns two instances configured as main_file_cache and main_file_osrs and uses them for config, model, animation/frame and landscape dependency reads.
close() deterministically closes every lazily opened index RandomAccessFile and then the shared data RandomAccessFile; main uses try/finally-style close handling for both stores.
